title: A RESPAWN IS NOT DRAGGED BACK INTO A STRONGHOLD
why: A stronghold fence keeps everyone on the side of it they stand on, and remembers that side on the player. A DEMO respawn moves the player but kept the old side, so a player who died inside a compound and respawned beside his mate outside it was pulled back through the fence into the compound on the very next frame, and one who died outside and respawned beside a mate inside was pushed out. Proven in headless Chromium: gate open, walked in, died, respawned 334 from the centre of a 240 compound beside a mate outside, and one frame later 223 from the centre, inside, away from the mate. A respawn now forgets the old sides, so the fence takes the side the player lands on.
now: A player who respawns beside a stronghold stays on the side he lands on instead of being pulled through the fence.
